biggest_catch: Your friend must open a qualifying Chase checking account through your exact personalized link — if they apply any other way, or either account is closed or restricted at payout time, you get nothing.
catches: Friend MUST apply through your personalized referral link; referrals who open an account any other way earn you nothing.
Only qualifying checking accounts count: Chase Total Checking, Premier Plus Checking, Sapphire Checking, or Private Client Checking.
Cap: 10 referrals ($500 total) per calendar year.
The referral offer becomes available to you approximately 30 days after your own account opening; JPMorgan Chase employees are excluded.
Bonus is deposited within 30 days after the friend opens, only if both accounts remain open and unrestricted at payout.

steps: Be a Chase personal checking customer with an eligible account (Total Checking, Premier Plus, Sapphire, or Private Client) — the referral offer becomes available about 30 days after account opening.
Copy your personalized referral link from the official Chase Refer-A-Friend page.
Share your unique link with friends (confirm you have consent before texting anyone).
Your friend must apply through YOUR link and open a qualifying Chase checking account.
Receive $50 for each qualifying referral, deposited into your primary checking account within 30 days of the friend opening (up to 10 per calendar year).
timing: Bonus deposited into your primary Chase checking account within 30 days after the referred friend opens their qualifying checking account.
